mode: Luna image-generation agents; one independent original atlas per character
base: Production 2D RPG animation sprite atlas, 2048x2048 square PNG with REAL transparent alpha. STRICT regular FOUR columns x FOUR rows, exactly SIXTEEN equal square cells, ONE full body of the SAME adult in EACH cell. No background, floor, shadow blobs, labels, grid lines, text or extra people. Polished crisp anime game illustration, refined mature face, natural anatomy, rich readable costume. Consistent identical character and outfit across sixteen poses, all facing screen RIGHT in three-quarter profile. Head, feet and weapon fully inside own cell with 8% padding, no overlap of neighboring cells. Body height about77% of cell, foot baseline90% cellheight. Weapon connected to hand, no large detached particles. Row1 lefttoright:0 neutral resting with weapon down;1 subtle breathing variant;2 subtle alert variant;3 battle-ready knees bent. Row2:4 windup;5 decisive attack fully extended right;6 sweeping strong attack different stance;7 recovery to ready. Row3:8 concentrate spell near chest;9 release small magic/ranged attack right;10 defensive crouch block;11 hit recoil holding torso. Row4:12 dodge low lean;13 defeated kneeling head bowed fullbody;14 victory raised hand/weapon;15 composed victory. Sixteen expressive coherent complete poses SAME EXACT character, actual transparency.
animalBase: Production 2D RPG creature animation atlas, transparent 2048x2048 PNG, exact four columns by four rows with one identical creature per cell, same species, markings, proportions and anatomy in every frame. No environment, ground shadow, labels, grid or detached magic. Each creature's wings, tails, fins, whiskers, horns, feathers and all limbs stay fully inside its own cell; transparent gutters separate all poses. Face screen right in three-quarter profile. Row1: 0 calm neutral idle; 1 tail/feather breathing shift; 2 alert head turn; 3 battle-ready crouch. Row2: 4 attack windup; 5 lunge/bite/claw strike; 6 leaping or sweeping attack; 7 recovery. Row3: 8 gather magical energy; 9 short breath/ranged attack with contained effect; 10 defensive brace; 11 hit recoil. Row4: 12 dodge; 13 defeated but intact pose; 14 proud victory stance or roar; 15 calm composed idle. The silhouette must remain recognizable at small screen size. Keep a single connected silhouette where possible; no rider unless the specific design says so.
